properties.name: Cumulus Energy Storage
properties.description:
Cumulus Energy Storage (Cumulus) aims to be the leading manufacturer and developer of grid-level rechargeable Copper/Zinc energy storage batteries with the lowest levelised cost of storage (LCOS) globally.

Large scale storage is an essential part of the future of energy. We need electricity super-storage to give industry the freedom of instantly available renewable electricity; give grid the capacity to deliver security of supply; and give time-shifting to renewables so that solar energy after sunset becomes reality.

The market drivers for energy storage are set in legislation. Increasing distributed renewables generation, especially the recent growth in solar PV on top of onshore and offshore wind, is causing pain points for grid infrastructure and incumbent generators; creating urgent global need for reliable low-cost, scalable grid-level energy storage.

Cumulus has taken the bold and visionary step of combining a 200 year old technology from one industry, with technology from two other industrial-scale processes, to create a disruptive opportunity – electricity super-storage – using patent granted technology in the form of a low-cost grid-scale rechargeable Copper/Zinc battery.

With financial support from the UK government and investment from business angels, Cumulus has extended from Sheffield to San Francisco, with laboratory facilities developing grid-connected full-scale prototypes. Pilot line production, followed by full production capacity, is supported by global component manufacturers and continental forming and assembly plants; delivering our super-storage products and services to customers through local project developers.

properties.name: Sthyr Energy Private Limited

Sthyr Energy Private Limited, a startup initiated at IIT Madras, is pioneering grid-scale energy storage for renewable power through zinc-air batteries as long-duration energy storage systems. 
Sthyr Energy was founded by Gunjan Kapadia, Akhil Kongara, and Muhammed Hamdan, all of whom are PhD from IIT Madras. Prof. Aravind Kumar Chandiran (IIT Madras) is a technology advisor and Mr. Shaaji John (Ohmium) is the market advisor to Sthyr Energy.

"Linkz ESS: Empowering the Future of Energy Storage Solutions"

Introduction:
In the rapidly evolving landscape of energy production and consumption, the integration of Energy Storage Systems (ESS) is becoming increasingly vital. Linkz ESS aims to be at the forefront of this transformative journey by revolutionizing how we harness and distribute energy. Our vision is to create an interconnected network of smart ESS units that not only store excess energy efficiently but also contribute to the growth of renewable energy sources. Here's an idea of how Linkz ESS can shape the future of ESS and new energy:

Key Components:

Advanced Battery Technology: Utilize cutting-edge battery technology, such as solid-state batteries, to improve energy density, charging/discharging efficiency, and overall system longevity. These innovations will enable rapid energy storage and release when needed, reducing waste and increasing overall system reliability.

Decentralized Network: Establish a decentralized network of ESS units that can be deployed at various scales - from residential homes to industrial facilities. These units will be interconnected through the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and control.

AI-Driven Energy Management: Implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms for predictive energy management. This technology can optimize when and how energy is stored and released, taking into account factors like weather forecasts, energy demand patterns, and market pricing.

Renewable Integration: Prioritize the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into the ESS network. Linkz ESS units can store excess energy generated during peak production times and release it when renewable sources are less productive, ensuring a continuous and reliable energy supply.

entity.name: Cumulus Energy Storage
entity.description:
Cumulus Energy Storage (Cumulus) aims to be the leading manufacturer and developer of grid-level rechargeable Copper/Zinc energy storage batteries with the lowest levelised cost of storage (LCOS) globally.

Large scale storage is an essential part of the future of energy. We need electricity super-storage to give industry the freedom of instantly available renewable electricity; give grid the capacity to deliver security of supply; and give time-shifting to renewables so that solar energy after sunset becomes reality.

The market drivers for energy storage are set in legislation. Increasing distributed renewables generation, especially the recent growth in solar PV on top of onshore and offshore wind, is causing pain points for grid infrastructure and incumbent generators; creating urgent global need for reliable low-cost, scalable grid-level energy storage.

Cumulus has taken the bold and visionary step of combining a 200 year old technology from one industry, with technology from two other industrial-scale processes, to create a disruptive opportunity – electricity super-storage – using patent granted technology in the form of a low-cost grid-scale rechargeable Copper/Zinc battery.

With financial support from the UK government and investment from business angels, Cumulus has extended from Sheffield to San Francisco, with laboratory facilities developing grid-connected full-scale prototypes. Pilot line production, followed by full production capacity, is supported by global component manufacturers and continental forming and assembly plants; delivering our super-storage products and services to customers through local project developers.

entity.description:
"Linkz ESS: Empowering the Future of Energy Storage Solutions"

Introduction:
In the rapidly evolving landscape of energy production and consumption, the integration of Energy Storage Systems (ESS) is becoming increasingly vital. Linkz ESS aims to be at the forefront of this transformative journey by revolutionizing how we harness and distribute energy. Our vision is to create an interconnected network of smart ESS units that not only store excess energy efficiently but also contribute to the growth of renewable energy sources. Here's an idea of how Linkz ESS can shape the future of ESS and new energy:

Key Components:

Advanced Battery Technology: Utilize cutting-edge battery technology, such as solid-state batteries, to improve energy density, charging/discharging efficiency, and overall system longevity. These innovations will enable rapid energy storage and release when needed, reducing waste and increasing overall system reliability.

Decentralized Network: Establish a decentralized network of ESS units that can be deployed at various scales - from residential homes to industrial facilities. These units will be interconnected through the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and control.

AI-Driven Energy Management: Implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms for predictive energy management. This technology can optimize when and how energy is stored and released, taking into account factors like weather forecasts, energy demand patterns, and market pricing.

Renewable Integration: Prioritize the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into the ESS network. Linkz ESS units can store excess energy generated during peak production times and release it when renewable sources are less productive, ensuring a continuous and reliable energy supply.

A Vertys é representante exclusiva da Renac Power no Brasil, maior fabricante de inversores solares do mundo, que utiliza tecnologia alemã para desenvolver soluções inteligentes para o mercado de energia solar. Tecnologia importada que é levada para as instalações dos sistemas fotovoltaicos em residências, empresas, indústrias e propriedades rurais.
 
A Vertys trabalha com uma grande variedade de modelos de inversores solares, um deles é o inversor solar híbrido, que tem a capacidade de operar em dois modos: on-grid e off-grid.

Para garantir entrega eficiente, a Vertys formou uma rede de distribuidores e integradores em todo o país, a partir da matriz e do centro de distribuição em Toledo no Paraná. E no ano passado, montou o segundo centro de distribuição em Campina Grande, na Paraíba e abriu duas filiais no sul do Brasil, para levar a energia solar com qualidade certificada e comprovada aos clientes.

Os parceiros Vertys contam com uma parceria 360° que oferece um sistema de gestão e orçamento que facilita toda a operação comercial. Contam também com suporte comercial, capacitação com treinamentos teóricos e práticos, apoio em ações de marketing e atendimento humanizado para tirar dúvidas sobre engenharia e estoque e logística. Somos uma indústria que apoia os parceiros para crescer e se desenvolver no mercado.

É construindo o futuro que se consolida o presente com soluções inovadoras.

At Cellect, we focus on supporting the future of utility-scale battery energy storage with our technical and commercial asset management platform. Our Mission

Unlike traditional tools repurposed from the solar or wind industries, Cellect designs platforms specifically for battery asset managers. We bring together energy storage expertise and data analytics to create solutions aimed at meeting the technical and commercial needs of our clients. Our goal is to help improve performance, minimize downtime, and extend the lifetime of battery assets.

Our Approach 

By combining energy storage expertise, renewable technology, and battery analytics, Cellect enhances the efficiency of utility-scale energy systems. Our battery analytics are designed to support system operations and provide valuable insights for users.

How are your batteries today?

Book a call with Cellect to discover our asset management solutions and gain insights into your batteries' technical and commercial performance.

properties.name: ZIVITA
properties.description:
About Zivita
 
Zivita is an energy systems startup focused on designing resilient storage solutions for unstable grid environments.
 
Across emerging markets, power infrastructure faces recurring outages, voltage instability, and rising backup costs. Yet most storage systems are built for ideal operating conditions — fixed capacity, predictable loads, and linear battery lifecycles.
 
We believe this assumption is flawed.
 
Zivita develops modular battery architectures designed for real-world grid volatility. Our Phase 01 initiative, Rewatt, focuses on structured second-life battery utilization — converting retired EV batteries into cost-effective, stationary energy storage systems through controlled diagnostics, BMS integration, and lifecycle-aware design.
 
Our approach prioritizes: • Real load-based capacity design
• Battery degradation accounting
• Lower lifecycle cost
• Circular energy utilization
• Reduced environmental externalities
 
We are building with engineering discipline, not trend momentum.
 
Zivita is a student-led startup from Government Engineering College, Thrissur, driven by the long-term vision of making distributed energy storage more adaptive, accessible, and economically rational.
 
We are actively collaborating with: – Battery engineers
– BMS specialists
– Power electronics experts
– Manufacturing mentors
– Clean-tech ecosystem partners
 
If you work in energy storage, EV systems, or grid infrastructure, we welcome meaningful conversations.

The Energy Storage Lab at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IITR) is a multidisciplinary research group focused on the development of advanced materials and technologies for next-generation energy storage systems. Advanced materials synthesis and structural engineering

Interface and surface modification
In-situ and ex-situ characterization techniques
Collaborations with academia, research institutions, and industry

In the rapidly evolving landscape of energy production and consumption, the integration of Energy Storage Systems (ESS) is becoming increasingly vital. Advanced Battery Technology: Utilize cutting-edge battery technology, such as solid-state batteries, to improve energy density, charging/discharging efficiency, and overall system longevity. Decentralized Network: Establish a decentralized network of ESS units that can be deployed at various scales - from residential homes to industrial facilities. These units will be interconnected through the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and control.

Renewable Integration: Prioritize the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into the ESS network. Linkz ESS units can store excess energy generated during peak production times and release it when renewable sources are less productive, ensuring a continuous and reliable energy supply.

entity.name: ZIVITA
entity.description:
About Zivita
 
Zivita is an energy systems startup focused on designing resilient storage solutions for unstable grid environments.
 
Across emerging markets, power infrastructure faces recurring outages, voltage instability, and rising backup costs. Yet most storage systems are built for ideal operating conditions — fixed capacity, predictable loads, and linear battery lifecycles.
 
We believe this assumption is flawed.
 
Zivita develops modular battery architectures designed for real-world grid volatility. Our Phase 01 initiative, Rewatt, focuses on structured second-life battery utilization — converting retired EV batteries into cost-effective, stationary energy storage systems through controlled diagnostics, BMS integration, and lifecycle-aware design.
 
Our approach prioritizes: • Real load-based capacity design
• Battery degradation accounting
• Lower lifecycle cost
• Circular energy utilization
• Reduced environmental externalities
 
We are building with engineering discipline, not trend momentum.
 
Zivita is a student-led startup from Government Engineering College, Thrissur, driven by the long-term vision of making distributed energy storage more adaptive, accessible, and economically rational.
 
We are actively collaborating with: – Battery engineers
– BMS specialists
– Power electronics experts
– Manufacturing mentors
– Clean-tech ecosystem partners
 
If you work in energy storage, EV systems, or grid infrastructure, we welcome meaningful conversations.

entity.name: Energy Storage Laboratory, Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee
entity.description:
The Energy Storage Lab at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IITR) is a multidisciplinary research group focused on the development of advanced materials and technologies for next-generation energy storage systems. Led by Prof. Yogesh Kumar Sharma, our lab integrates expertise in electrochemistry, solid-state science, materials chemistry, and nanotechnology to address critical challenges in energy sustainability.

Our research spans a broad range of cutting-edge storage systems, including lithium-ion, sodium-ion, solid-state, metal–air, and dual-ion batteries, with an emphasis on improving energy density, safety, life cycle, and affordability. We work on designing and synthesizing novel electrode materials, solid and liquid electrolytes, and functional interfaces, aiming to bridge the gap between fundamental science and scalable energy solutions.

The lab is actively involved in:
Advanced materials synthesis and structural engineering
Electrochemical performance optimization
Interface and surface modification
In-situ and ex-situ characterization techniques
Collaborations with academia, research institutions, and industry

With state-of-the-art facilities and a strong academic foundation, we strive to develop high-performance and environmentally friendly battery technologies for applications ranging from consumer electronics and electric vehicles to grid-scale storage and renewable energy integration.

We are committed to fostering innovation, academic excellence, and collaborative research. Our lab welcomes passionate researchers, students, and industry partners to join us in shaping the future of energy.

entity.name: Cumulus Energy Storage
entity.description:
Cumulus Energy Storage (Cumulus) aims to be the leading manufacturer and developer of grid-level rechargeable Copper/Zinc energy storage batteries with the lowest levelised cost of storage (LCOS) globally.

Large scale storage is an essential part of the future of energy. We need electricity super-storage to give industry the freedom of instantly available renewable electricity; give grid the capacity to deliver security of supply; and give time-shifting to renewables so that solar energy after sunset becomes reality.

The market drivers for energy storage are set in legislation. Increasing distributed renewables generation, especially the recent growth in solar PV on top of onshore and offshore wind, is causing pain points for grid infrastructure and incumbent generators; creating urgent global need for reliable low-cost, scalable grid-level energy storage.

Cumulus has taken the bold and visionary step of combining a 200 year old technology from one industry, with technology from two other industrial-scale processes, to create a disruptive opportunity – electricity super-storage – using patent granted technology in the form of a low-cost grid-scale rechargeable Copper/Zinc battery.

With financial support from the UK government and investment from business angels, Cumulus has extended from Sheffield to San Francisco, with laboratory facilities developing grid-connected full-scale prototypes. Pilot line production, followed by full production capacity, is supported by global component manufacturers and continental forming and assembly plants; delivering our super-storage products and services to customers through local project developers.

In the rapidly evolving landscape of energy production and consumption, the integration of Energy Storage Systems (ESS) is becoming increasingly vital. Here's an idea of how Linkz ESS can shape the future of ESS and new energy:

Advanced Battery Technology: Utilize cutting-edge battery technology, such as solid-state batteries, to improve energy density, charging/discharging efficiency, and overall system longevity. Decentralized Network: Establish a decentralized network of ESS units that can be deployed at various scales - from residential homes to industrial facilities. These units will be interconnected through the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and control.

AI-Driven Energy Management: Implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms for predictive energy management. This technology can optimize when and how energy is stored and released, taking into account factors like weather forecasts, energy demand patterns, and market pricing.

Renewable Integration: Prioritize the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into the ESS network. Linkz ESS units can store excess energy generated during peak production times and release it when renewable sources are less productive, ensuring a continuous and reliable energy supply.

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

properties.name: Cumulus Energy Storage

Cumulus Energy Storage (Cumulus) aims to be the leading manufacturer and developer of grid-level rechargeable Copper/Zinc energy storage batteries with the lowest levelised cost of storage (LCOS) globally.

Large scale storage is an essential part of the future of energy. We need electricity super-storage to give industry the freedom of instantly available renewable electricity; give grid the capacity to deliver security of supply; and give time-shifting to renewables so that solar energy after sunset becomes reality.

The market drivers for energy storage are set in legislation. Increasing distributed renewables generation, especially the recent growth in solar PV on top of onshore and offshore wind, is causing pain points for grid infrastructure and incumbent generators; creating urgent global need for reliable low-cost, scalable grid-level energy storage.

With financial support from the UK government and investment from business angels, Cumulus has extended from Sheffield to San Francisco, with laboratory facilities developing grid-connected full-scale prototypes. Pilot line production, followed by full production capacity, is supported by global component manufacturers and continental forming and assembly plants; delivering our super-storage products and services to customers through local project developers.

The Energy Storage Lab at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IITR) is a multidisciplinary research group focused on the development of advanced materials and technologies for next-generation energy storage systems. Advanced materials synthesis and structural engineering
Electrochemical performance optimization
Interface and surface modification
In-situ and ex-situ characterization techniques
Collaborations with academia, research institutions, and industry

properties.name: Rocinante
properties.description:
Rocinante builds GTM foundations for founders of B2B operational and technical software, both AI-native companies and SaaS, from early traction through repeatable sales motion.

The founders we work with are technical, product, or operator-led. They built something that works. They're trying to figure out how to sell it consistently, scale it past their own relationships, and arrive at Series A or B diligence with numbers that hold up to scrutiny.

The thesis behind how we work: a founder who hasn't personally carried a quota can't hire, manage, or evaluate a sales team. You can't delegate what you don't understand. The most common failure mode we see isn't bad salespeople. It's founders who hired before they had something worth handing off.

Rocinante makes the founder dangerous first. That means a validated ICP, a playbook the founder has run themselves, a RevOps stack that answers real questions, and an outbound motion tested on real buyers. Only then do we build the machine and the team around it.

What we build, scoped to stage:
— ICP validation and micro-segment buyer personas
— Founder sales coaching and quota-carrying alongside us
— Sales playbook, call frameworks, objection library
— RevOps: CRM, email infrastructure, data model, reporting
— AI SDR and outbound agent deployment
— Hiring support for first AEs and early sales leadership
— Investor-grade GTM instrumentation for fundraising

We work primarily in three verticals: AI infrastructure and ML tooling, supply chain and logistics software, and B2B commerce infrastructure. We serve companies from $300K to $50M ARR.

We don't take healthcare clients.

If you're a technical or operator founder between $300K and $10M ARR who is carrying the sales motion yourself and want it to become repeatable, that's the right starting point.

## A

properties.name: Cogent Equity
properties.description:
Most transaction risk isn’t created during a sale process - it’s exposed by it.
 
By the time a business goes to market, many of the factors that determine value and deal certainty are already in place. We work with business owners and their advisors to evaluate those factors before the market does.
 
At Cogent Equity, we represent a limited number of companies with $1M to $10M in adjusted EBITDA, typically with long operating histories and strong underlying performance. Our focus is not just on running a process, but on ensuring the business is positioned to succeed in one.
 
This work often begins before a sale is imminent. We evaluate the business the way a sophisticated buyer would - identifying value constraints, aligning expectations, and addressing issues that would otherwise surface during diligence.
 
For advisors, the situations where it tends to be most useful to involve us are:
 
 - An owner is beginning to consider a sale in the next 1–3 years 
 - Valuation expectations are unclear or misaligned 
 - There are known or suspected issues that could impact a transaction 
 
Our perspective is shaped by firsthand experience as owners , operators, buyers, and sellers across nine different industries - allowing me to evaluate businesses the way a sophisticated buyer actually would.
 
While much of our work begins before a sale, we also represent owners through a structured, buyer-focused transaction process when the timing is right.
 
The objective is not just the right deal, but the right buyer - and a process that holds together from start to finish.

properties.name: Linkz ESS
properties.description:
"Linkz ESS: Empowering the Future of Energy Storage Solutions"

Introduction:
In the rapidly evolving landscape of energy production and consumption, the integration of Energy Storage Systems (ESS) is becoming increasingly vital. Linkz ESS aims to be at the forefront of this transformative journey by revolutionizing how we harness and distribute energy. Our vision is to create an interconnected network of smart ESS units that not only store excess energy efficiently but also contribute to the growth of renewable energy sources. Here's an idea of how Linkz ESS can shape the future of ESS and new energy:

Key Components:

Advanced Battery Technology: Utilize cutting-edge battery technology, such as solid-state batteries, to improve energy density, charging/discharging efficiency, and overall system longevity. These innovations will enable rapid energy storage and release when needed, reducing waste and increasing overall system reliability.

Decentralized Network: Establish a decentralized network of ESS units that can be deployed at various scales - from residential homes to industrial facilities. These units will be interconnected through the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and control.

AI-Driven Energy Management: Implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms for predictive energy management. This technology can optimize when and how energy is stored and released, taking into account factors like weather forecasts, energy demand patterns, and market pricing.

Renewable Integration: Prioritize the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into the ESS network. Linkz ESS units can store excess energy generated during peak production times and release it when renewable sources are less productive, ensuring a continuous and reliable energy supply.

entity.name: Cumulus Energy Storage
entity.description:
Cumulus Energy Storage (Cumulus) aims to be the leading manufacturer and developer of grid-level rechargeable Copper/Zinc energy storage batteries with the lowest levelised cost of storage (LCOS) globally.

Large scale storage is an essential part of the future of energy. We need electricity super-storage to give industry the freedom of instantly available renewable electricity; give grid the capacity to deliver security of supply; and give time-shifting to renewables so that solar energy after sunset becomes reality.

The market drivers for energy storage are set in legislation. Increasing distributed renewables generation, especially the recent growth in solar PV on top of onshore and offshore wind, is causing pain points for grid infrastructure and incumbent generators; creating urgent global need for reliable low-cost, scalable grid-level energy storage.

Cumulus has taken the bold and visionary step of combining a 200 year old technology from one industry, with technology from two other industrial-scale processes, to create a disruptive opportunity – electricity super-storage – using patent granted technology in the form of a low-cost grid-scale rechargeable Copper/Zinc battery.

With financial support from the UK government and investment from business angels, Cumulus has extended from Sheffield to San Francisco, with laboratory facilities developing grid-connected full-scale prototypes. Pilot line production, followed by full production capacity, is supported by global component manufacturers and continental forming and assembly plants; delivering our super-storage products and services to customers through local project developers.

SupplyET helps manufacturing companies make better strategic decisions for complex production networks.

Volatile markets force manufacturers to transform their production network strategy, impacting plants, products, resources, suppliers, and demand scenarios. But many critical decisions are still made with spreadsheets, static planning models, or fragmented systems. This makes it difficult to see bottlenecks early, understand capacity limits, compare production options, or react confidently to changing demand and supply conditions.

SupplyET solves this by turning the production network into a transparent, reasoning-capable decision model. Our software maps plants, products, resources, capacities, and supply relationships, then uses AI-augmented optimization and scenario analysis to evaluate what the network can realistically deliver.

This helps companies identify bottlenecks, assess capacity utilization, compare sourcing and production alternatives, and understand the impact of future changes before they become operational problems.

With SupplyET, manufacturers can move from reactive, manual planning to data-driven production network decisions that improve efficiency, resilience, and long-term readiness.

The founders we work with are technical, product, or operator-led. They built something that works. They're trying to figure out how to sell it consistently, scale it past their own relationships, and arrive at Series A or B diligence with numbers that hold up to scrutiny.

The thesis behind how we work: a founder who hasn't personally carried a quota can't hire, manage, or evaluate a sales team. You can't delegate what you don't understand. The most common failure mode we see isn't bad salespeople. It's founders who hired before they had something worth handing off.

Rocinante makes the founder dangerous first. That means a validated ICP, a playbook the founder has run themselves, a RevOps stack that answers real questions, and an outbound motion tested on real buyers. Only then do we build the machine and the team around it.

What we build, scoped to stage:
— ICP validation and micro-segment buyer personas
— Founder sales coaching and quota-carrying alongside us
— Sales playbook, call frameworks, objection library
— RevOps: CRM, email infrastructure, data model, reporting
— AI SDR and outbound agent deployment
— Hiring support for first AEs and early sales leadership
— Investor-grade GTM instrumentation for fundraising

We work primarily in three verticals: AI infrastructure and ML tooling, supply chain and logistics software, and B2B commerce infrastructure. We serve companies from $300K to $50M ARR.

entity.name: Cogent Equity
entity.description:
Most transaction risk isn’t created during a sale process - it’s exposed by it.
 
By the time a business goes to market, many of the factors that determine value and deal certainty are already in place. We work with business owners and their advisors to evaluate those factors before the market does.
 
At Cogent Equity, we represent a limited number of companies with $1M to $10M in adjusted EBITDA, typically with long operating histories and strong underlying performance. Our focus is not just on running a process, but on ensuring the business is positioned to succeed in one.
 
This work often begins before a sale is imminent. We evaluate the business the way a sophisticated buyer would - identifying value constraints, aligning expectations, and addressing issues that would otherwise surface during diligence.
 
For advisors, the situations where it tends to be most useful to involve us are:
 
 - An owner is beginning to consider a sale in the next 1–3 years 
 - Valuation expectations are unclear or misaligned 
 - There are known or suspected issues that could impact a transaction 
 
Our perspective is shaped by firsthand experience as owners , operators, buyers, and sellers across nine different industries - allowing me to evaluate businesses the way a sophisticated buyer actually would.
 
While much of our work begins before a sale, we also represent owners through a structured, buyer-focused transaction process when the timing is right.
 
The objective is not just the right deal, but the right buyer - and a process that holds together from start to finish.

entity.name: Linkz ESS

"Linkz ESS: Empowering the Future of Energy Storage Solutions"

Introduction:
In the rapidly evolving landscape of energy production and consumption, the integration of Energy Storage Systems (ESS) is becoming increasingly vital. Linkz ESS aims to be at the forefront of this transformative journey by revolutionizing how we harness and distribute energy. Our vision is to create an interconnected network of smart ESS units that not only store excess energy efficiently but also contribute to the growth of renewable energy sources. Here's an idea of how Linkz ESS can shape the future of ESS and new energy:

Key Components:

Advanced Battery Technology: Utilize cutting-edge battery technology, such as solid-state batteries, to improve energy density, charging/discharging efficiency, and overall system longevity. These innovations will enable rapid energy storage and release when needed, reducing waste and increasing overall system reliability.

Decentralized Network: Establish a decentralized network of ESS units that can be deployed at various scales - from residential homes to industrial facilities. These units will be interconnected through the Internet of Things (IoT) for real-time monitoring and control.

AI-Driven Energy Management: Implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms for predictive energy management. This technology can optimize when and how energy is stored and released, taking into account factors like weather forecasts, energy demand patterns, and market pricing.

Renewable Integration: Prioritize the integration of renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind, into the ESS network. Linkz ESS units can store excess energy generated during peak production times and release it when renewable sources are less productive, ensuring a continuous and reliable energy supply.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of

You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.
